evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp and wallet_resendwallettransactions.py to alter periodic wallet transaction rebroadcast behavior.
rationale: Eliminates an unintended privacy leak where wallets unconditionally rebroadcast transactions already present in the mempool. As noted in the description, unconditional rebroadcast 'signals to peers that the node has a special interest in the transaction, leaking the user's IP and wallet ownership', an issue long recognized as a privacy flaw.
